scenario_description.fi: Pieni konepaja, tulos on positiivinen mutta kassa on tiukalla nyt ja kriittinen kolmen viikon päästä, koska isot ostolaskut erääntyvät ennen myyntilaskujen maksuja.
scenario_description.en: A small machine shop with a positive result but a tight cash position that becomes critical in three weeks, because large purchase invoices fall due before sales invoices are paid.

parameters_from_language_model.notes: Positive P&L; purchase invoices cluster before sales collections (~week 3).
